item.title: Version 1.0.0 "Good Food"
item.description:
This release contain the first full fledged version of the Marco's Trattoria Website.

It includes PWA support and all of the basic pages

Pages included are:

  • Home
  • About
  • Book
  • Contact
  • Accessibility
  • License
  • Menu
  • Recipes
